motivation: Avoid a procurement disadvantage as consumption-based pricing becomes the norm and enterprises require governed token spend before scaling agent rollout.

motivation: Curb per-seat token bills running $200-$2,000+ per developer monthly, where ungoverned autonomy and bloated context windows drive the steepest cost escalation.
